name: Pair Up
summary: Pair Up is an arcade-puzzle hybrid that combines a traditional concentration memory matching game with falling-block survival mechanics similar to Tetris. The player is presented with a grid where the primary objective is to select and flip pairs of hidden cards. A progressive on-screen timer bar continuously fills, whenever the bar reaches its maximum capacity, an entire new row of unmatched cards is spawned and pushed onto the playing field from the bottom.
